title: Incorrect condition for adding envvars to help output
detail: The code checks `if not envvar:` after potentially assigning a string to `envvar`. This condition is true only when `envvar` is falsy (e.g., empty string or empty list), so it skips adding the `envvars` entry for valid non-empty strings. As a result, options with a non-empty `envvar` string will not display the envvar hint in the help text, breaking expected behavior.
note: Describes the planted negation: env vars that are set are left out of the help.

title: Incorrect header normalization
detail: The code replaces any header name that is not exactly "content-type" (case-insensitive) with the literal string "Content-Type". This means that all custom headers are overwritten to be "Content-Type", losing their original names and values. It also prevents setting multiple distinct headers and can cause unintended behavior when the client sends requests.
note: Describes the planted flip: every other header is renamed to Content-Type.
